answer_2.quote: We adopt the popular Exact Match (EM) and numeracy-focused F 1 score to measure model performance on TAT-QA.

answer_4.quote: The human performance is evaluated by asking annotators to answer 50 randomly sampled hybrid contexts (containing 301 questions) from our test set.
answer_4.guideline: The human performance is still not 100% correct because our questions require relatively heavy cognitive load like tedious numerical calculations.
